notes: Conjecture tau(a(n)-1) = prime(n)-1 false: a(4) = 7, tau(6) = 4 != 6 (A092967_conjecture_false_n4, A092967.lean). Since a(n)-1 is squarefree, tau is a power of 2, so equality needs prime(n) a Fermat prime: holds at n = 1, 2, 3, 7; fails at n = 55 (omega = 15) and n = 6543 (omega >= 18, explicit witness); open only for unknown Fermat primes > 65537. Name says prime factors < n but data use <= n. Outside Lean: none. n = 55 and 6543 are script-only (probable primes); the power-of-2 argument is paper.
